evidence_boundary: Local approximate convention: gross forward target returns, no fees or execution. The neutralizer is the frozen local approximation (median+/-3*1.4826*MAD winsorization, prior-day equal-weight OLS on 10 style factors and 32 industry dummies); it is not the official BARRA implementation. All three months are used development windows, so none is independent confirmation. Stress buckets use trailing 20-day medians and have few days.
scope: Frozen V3-recipe TLOB, MLPLOB and dual-scale patch checkpoints replayed on 2023-11, 2024-01 and 2024-03; pre-declared equal-weight arms scored on raw and prior-day-exposure-neutralized scores.
